title: Control Your Emotions
coreMove: Let the feeling report information without letting it choose the next sentence, email, or move for you.
sourcePressure: This chapter belongs to Perception, so it must teach cleaner seeing before it teaches action or endurance. Source sidecar ch03 exists and provides partial-source support only; no full text is frozen. For "Control Your Emotions", the pressure is to teach this exact move: Let the feeling report information without letting it choose the next sentence, email, or move for you.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version turns the chapter into generic mindset advice instead of a precise discipline of reading the obstacle cleanly. For "Control Your Emotions", avoid replacing the chapter move with the whole book thesis.

sourceAnchors.name: John D. Rockefeller
sourceAnchors.detail: Frozen notes support Rockefeller only as a narrow anchor for steadiness under pressure.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The Rockefeller reference should stay spare: pressure is real, but reaction does not get the chair.

hook: A generic obstacle appears and teaches control your emotions

counterintuition: The obstacle is actually a blessing
